request.system: You write graph.json files for explAIn-it, which turns a flow into an explainer video. graph.json is { version: 1, title, nodes, edges, zones }; a node { id, label, kind, icon?, zone?, category? } with kind "actor" | "service" | "database" | "queue" | "document" | "decision" | "external"; an edge { id, from, to, label?, category? }; a zone { id, label, category? }. No other fields. Labels ≤ 24 characters. Ids are unique across nodes, edges and zones, and a node or zone id may not be a Mermaid word such as "end". Call get_guide first for the full formats, how to tell the story, and a worked example. Answer with the JSON object only.

messages.content: Draft graph.json for this flow: A user forgets their password. The web app looks up their account and emails them a one-time link; they open it and choose a new password.

{"version":1,"title":"Password reset","nodes":[{"id":"user","label":"User","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"web_app","label":"Web app","kind":"service","icon":"globe","zone":"our_system"},{"id":"accounts_db","label":"Account database","kind":"database","icon":"database","zone":"our_system"},{"id":"email_provider","label":"Email provider","kind":"external","icon":"mail"},{"id":"reset_link","label":"One-time link","kind":"document","icon":"link"}],"edges":[{"id":"forgot_request","from":"user","to":"web_app","label":"Forgets password, asks for reset"},{"id":"lookup_account","from":"web_app","to":"accounts_db","label":"Look up account"},{"id":"create_link","from":"web_app","to":"reset_link","label":"Create one-time link"},{"id":"send_email","from":"web_app","to":"email_provider","label":"Send link by email"},{"id":"deliver_email","from":"email_provider","to":"user","label":"Delivers the email"},{"id":"open_link","from":"user","to":"web_app","label":"Opens the link"},{"id":"set_password","from":"web_app","to":"accounts_db","label":"Sets new password"}],"zones":[{"id":"our_system","label":"Our system"}]}
